About IMA

We design light that feels like home.

IMA LIGHTING is a Tehran design studio and manufacturer. Since 2014 we have created luminaires that combine honest materials, precise engineering and a warm, natural quality of light.

  • Natural colour. CRI 98 for true, flattering colours.
  • Tunable white. From candlelight 2000K to daylight 6500K.
  • Built to last. 50,000 hours and a 10-year warranty.
